name: Taiwan-Asia Semiconductor Corporation
summary: Taiwan-Asia Semiconductor Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of semiconductor components in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers sensing devices, such as photodiode, phototransistor, and phototriac; power devices, including power MOSFET, TVS diode, zener diode, and resistor; and general and high brightness LED, and VCSEL. The company's products are used in consumer and wearable, industry, automotive, home appliance, security, display, and lighting applications. Taiwan-Asia Semiconductor Corporation was formerly known as Opto Tech Corporation. Taiwan-Asia Semiconductor Corporation was founded in 1983 and is based in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.
